annotations.title: Make a PDF invoice from invoice fields, with a signed receipt of its hash

description: Make a clean PDF invoice from invoice fields, and get back a signed, dated receipt of the PDF's hash, so either side can later show which invoice was made and when. Send: number, issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional due_date, currency (USD, EUR, GBP ... 43 supported), seller {name, address, tax_id, contact}, buyer {name, address, ...}, items [{description, quantity, unit_price}] (up to 40), optional tax_lines [{label, rate_percent OR amount}], notes, payment_terms. Every number, rate and tax line is yours: we only add them up (half-up rounding to the currency's smallest unit); no tax advice, no tax rules, no checking of tax ids. Moves no money and makes no payment link: web addresses and links (dotted names, IP addresses, schemes such as http: or pay:) are refused in every text field. Free, no sign-up, 100 invoices a day per caller. Stores nothing: the signed receipt holds the number, dates, totals and hashes, never names or addresses. Text must use Western European letters (the Windows-1252 set; accented Latin letters, euro, pound, yen). Answer: pdf_base64, totals, signed observation, receipt. Docs: https://llpro.ai/invoice-maker

currency.description: Three-letter code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the issue date.

quantity.description: More than 0 and at most 1,000,000, up to 4 decimal places (a number, or text such as "2.5").

unit_price.description: At most 1,000,000,000 in size, up to 4 decimal places; a line may not exceed 10,000,000,000 and the total 100,000,000,000; may be negative for a credit line (the invoice total may not be negative).

number.description: Invoice number: letters, digits, space and . _ / # - (1 to 40).

payment_terms.description: Plain words, for example 'Net 30. Bank transfer, account details sent separately.' No web addresses.

address.description: Up to 6 lines (list of strings, or one string with line breaks), 80 characters each.

contact.description: An email address or phone number. No web addresses.

amount.description: A fixed tax amount instead of a rate (0 or more).

rate_percent.description: 0 to 100, up to 4 decimal places, applied to the subtotal. Your number, not ours.
